text:
incident-bot: ALERT — elevated error-rate & latency for /v1/generate (hosted-prod). p95 latency crossed 2.5s, errors increased ~8% in last 6m. Auto-runbooks: kvcache-thresholds, speculative-decoder-check. Paging: @jamie oncall.

jamie (oncall): grabbing. seeing spikes in continuous-batching CPU and kvcache evictions on nodepool-a. shots: `kvcache_evictions_total` jumped x10 at 12:14 UTC.

jamie (oncall): @sasha can you dump the offending pod logs? i'm seeing repeated `draft/target mismatch` warnings in decode path.

sasha (sre): on it. pulling logs from runtime-rls-3. snippet: 
```
W decode_speculative.cpp: draft-target-sync failed: KV_MISS seq=24
I kv_cache.cpp: evicting prefix 0x7f9a... reason=hot-loop
E batching.cpp: continuous_batch length>256 detected, forcing flush
```

sasha (sre): also seeing a tight loop of prefetch requests to the kvcache—many small prefetched keys for the same request id. looks like speculative decoder is prefetching both draft & target aggressively.

raj (eng-runtime): that matches a recent opt we shipped to prefetch more aggressively for low-latency targets (rollout 28). suspect interaction with continuous batching: prefetches allocate KV entries and cause churn, which then increases batching delays and forces more prefetches -> positive feedback.

ingrid (eng-ml): speculative-decoding changes did increase parallel draft fetches, but we thought the cache would absorb it. maybe dynamic TTLs didn't kick in due to size hints.

courtney (prod-support): any idea on customer impact? I'm tracking API errors flagged as 502/504 and several large customers reported degraded throughput. CC: @sales.

jamie (oncall): quick customer impact: ~4% of 99 tenants saw >3x latency and ~12 of them had transient 5xx. no retries yet flagged as data-loss. writing incident slack thread and paging SREs.

sasha (sre): mitigation plan I propose: 1) throttle speculative prefetch (feature flag flip), 2) reduce continuous-batch max size to 128 on nodepool-a, 3) revert rollout 28 if needed. Can do 1+2 as quick flags.

raj (eng-runtime): agree. I can flip `spec_prefetch_allowed=false` for rollout-28 within 90s and patch batching config to `max_batch_tokens=128`. prepping patch now.

sasha (sre): doing a canary change on 3 pods first. applying to runtime-rls-1..3.

incident-bot: DEPLOY START — user=raj target=runtime-rls-1..3 flags:spec_prefetch=false batching.max_tokens=128

sasha (sre): canary applied. monitoring.

~90s later~

jamie (oncall): canary looks good: p95 back down ~700ms on those pods, evictions dropped 70% in canary. no new 5xx observed on canary traffic.

ingrid (eng-ml): good signal. likely the prefetch loop was amplifying KV pressure.

raj (eng-runtime): rolling change to remaining nodepool-a now. will do staged rollouts 4 min per batch.

courtney (prod-support): customers seeing improvement in support tickets. pushing official note to affected accounts: "We observed elevated latency due to an internal caching interaction; mitigation applied, monitoring continues."

sasha (sre): full rollout completed. metrics: overall p95 dropped from 2.6s->0.75s, error-rate back to baseline. continuous-batch flush events reduced x9.

jamie (oncall): moving to post-incident actions: root cause likely prefetch aggressiveness combined with continuous batching policy mismatch causing kvcache churn and draft/target divergence warnings. suggested follow-ups:
- revert or rework speculative prefetch logic so it respects cache size hints and batching load.
- add a safety gate: if `kvcache_evictions_total` spikes > threshold, automatically disable speculative prefetch on that pool.
- telemetry: add a dashboard tile showing prefetch/request ratio, kvcache_evictions, speculative-diff warnings.

raj (eng-runtime): notes for immediate follow-up: create a small throttling service side flag `spec_prefetch_budget_per_request` default 1. we'll also add API to read `kv_free_slots` and avoid over-prefetching.

ingrid (eng-ml): i'll open a PR to change the decoder to prefer target fetches and only prefetch drafts when KV free slots>10%. also will add unit tests for prefix churn.

courtney (prod-support): coordinating a brief customer-facing RCA to send in 24h. will include what changed and mitigations.

jamie (oncall): incident severity: Sev2 — partial degradation, customers affected but no data loss. incidents board updated. tagging for postmortem: kvcache, batching, speculative-decoder, rollout-28.

sasha (sre): oncall handoff: @jamie handing to @sasha for overnight monitoring. I'll keep an eye and we can schedule the postmortem tomorrow 15:00 UTC.

jamie (oncall): handing off. summary pinned above. thanks all :thumbsup:

incident-bot: INCIDENT RESOLVED by saga: mitigation applied, p95 and error-rate returned to baseline. Incident ticket #INC-2024-418 created and assigned to eng-runtime (raj) for follow-up.
